description: User and role management: CREATE and DROP USER (with and without a PASSWORD), CREATE and DROP ROLE, GRANT and REVOKE a role to a user, GRANT and REVOKE a privilege to a role, and the SHOW commands that report all of it. Two rules are pinned that are easy to get wrong. A privilege must be DEFINED for the object type it is granted on - live-verified, GRANT SELECT ON DATABASE fails 'Invalid object type DATABASE for privilege SELECT' while USAGE ON DATABASE is exactly how a database is shared. And the implicit PUBLIC membership is NEVER listed: a fresh user shows zero grants, and an EXPLICIT GRANT ROLE PUBLIC TO USER adds no row either, measured on a real account, because every user is in PUBLIC so the grant has nothing to report - while granting any OTHER role shows a row immediately, both for a plain user and for one created with a password and DEFAULT_ROLE = 'PUBLIC'. GRANT ALL expands into individual privilege rows with no row named ALL. The four system roles are always present. Converted 1:1 from security/UserRoleTest (now retired); the Java scanned SHOW output POSITIONALLY, and these steps read the same rows BY NAME through RESULT_SCAN.

steps.sql: CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS alice
SHOW USERS
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'ALICE'
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS bob PASSWORD = 'secret123'
SHOW USERS
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'BOB'
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS temp_user
SHOW USERS
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'TEMP_USER'
DROP USER temp_user
SHOW USERS
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'TEMP_USER'
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS analyst
SHOW ROLES
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'ANALYST'
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS temp_role
SHOW ROLES
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'TEMP_ROLE'
DROP ROLE temp_role
SHOW ROLES
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'TEMP_ROLE'
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS charlie
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS developer
GRANT ROLE developer TO USER charlie
SHOW GRANTS TO USER charlie
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'DEVELOPER'
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS dave
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS tester
GRANT ROLE tester TO USER dave
REVOKE ROLE tester FROM USER dave
SHOW GRANTS TO USER dave
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'TESTER'
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS priv_test_db
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS data_reader
GRANT SELECT ON DATABASE priv_test_db TO ROLE data_reader
GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE priv_test_db TO ROLE data_reader
SHOW GRANTS TO ROLE data_reader
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "privilege" = 'USAGE' AND "name" = 'PRIV_TEST_DB'
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE products (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS writer
GRANT INSERT ON TABLE products TO ROLE writer
REVOKE INSERT ON TABLE products FROM ROLE writer
SHOW GRANTS TO ROLE writer
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "privilege" = 'INSERT' AND "name" = 'PRODUCTS'
SHOW ROLES
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" IN ('SYSADMIN','USERADMIN','SECURITYADMIN','PUBLIC')
CREATE WAREHOUSE IF NOT EXISTS grant_test_wh
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS wh_user
GRANT USAGE ON WAREHOUSE grant_test_wh TO ROLE wh_user
SHOW GRANTS ON WAREHOUSE grant_test_wh
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "privilege" = 'USAGE' AND "grantee_name" = 'WH_USER'
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE all_priv_test (id INTEGER)
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_role
GRANT ALL ON TABLE all_priv_test TO ROLE admin_role
SHOW GRANTS TO ROLE admin_role
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "privilege" = 'ALL'
SHOW GRANTS TO ROLE admin_role
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "privilege" = 'SELECT' AND "name" LIKE '%ALL_PRIV_TEST'
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS test_public_user
SHOW GRANTS TO USER test_public_user
GRANT ROLE PUBLIC TO USER test_public_user
SHOW GRANTS TO USER test_public_user
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS listed_role
GRANT ROLE listed_role TO USER test_public_user
SHOW GRANTS TO USER test_public_user
SELECT "name" FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS test_public_user2 PASSWORD = 'pass123' DEFAULT_ROLE = 'PUBLIC'
SHOW GRANTS TO USER test_public_user2
GRANT ROLE PUBLIC TO USER test_public_user2
SHOW GRANTS TO USER test_public_user2
